shelters.name: Connecticut Humane Society - Newington
shelters.description: Established in 1881, Connecticut's oldest and most comprehensive animal welfare organization. The leading resource for companion animal welfare through adoption services, medical care, education, and prevention of cruelty.

shelters.name: Connecticut Humane Society - Westport
shelters.description: Westport location of Connecticut Humane Society providing adoption services, veterinary care, and community programs for Fairfield County.

shelters.name: Connecticut Humane Society - Quaker Hill
shelters.description: Eastern Connecticut location of Connecticut Humane Society serving New London County and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: Protectors of Animals
shelters.description: 501c3 non-profit no-kill shelter formed in 1975 to rescue abandoned, abused and stray cats and dogs. All volunteer, all donation organization.

shelters.name: The Animal Haven
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter operating since 1948, providing humane refuge to homeless, abandoned and surrendered cats and dogs.

shelters.name: Danbury Animal Welfare Society (DAWS)
shelters.description: Non-profit, volunteer-run, no-kill animal shelter promoting responsible pet guardianship and working to end animal overpopulation through education and programs.

shelters.name: SPCA of Connecticut
shelters.description: Connecticut SPCA providing animal welfare services including adoption, rescue, and community education.

shelters.name: Meriden Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1893, non-profit no-kill animal shelter and rescue facility serving Connecticut.

shelters.name: PAWS - Pet Animal Welfare Society
shelters.description: Helping animals in need since 1962 with dedicated staff and volunteers providing shelter, medical attention, and love to dogs and cats.

shelters.name: New Haven Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Robin I. Kroogman New Haven Animal Shelter serving the city of New Haven with animal control and adoption services.

shelters.name: Friends of the New Haven Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Nonprofit supporting the New Haven Animal Shelter through fundraising and volunteer programs.

shelters.name: Animal Friends of Connecticut
shelters.description: Non-profit, no-kill rescue and shelter serving the local community in New Britain and central Connecticut.

shelters.name: NECCOG Animal Services
shelters.description: Regional animal services program serving 20 towns in northeastern Connecticut. Found homes for more than 13,000 pets since 2003.

shelters.name: Rose Hope Animal Refuge
shelters.description: Small non-profit no-kill animal rescue, strictly volunteer organization with adoption center in Waterbury PetSmart.

shelters.name: New Fairfield-Sherman Animal Welfare Society (NFSAW)
shelters.description: Non-profit organization dedicated to animal welfare offering adoption, foster, volunteer, and donation opportunities.

shelters.name: Compassion For Cats of New London County
shelters.description: 100% volunteer-run cat shelter using all donations for cats including food, litter, and medical care.

shelters.name: Connecticut Cat Connection
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving the Hartford area with adoption and community cat programs.

shelters.name: Hearts United Cat Rescue
shelters.description: Non-profit, all volunteer, no-kill rescue group whose mission is to unite families and felines.

shelters.name: Second Chance Animal Rescue of Connecticut
shelters.description: Verified no-kill shelter providing rescue and adoption services across Connecticut.

shelters.name: OakTree Crew
shelters.description: Companion animal rescue focusing on unwanted, abandoned, stray and feral feline population within the community.

shelters.name: Save All Dogs Rescue
shelters.description: Dog rescue organization serving the Hartford area with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Ridgefield Operation for Animal Rescue (ROAR)
shelters.description: Community-based nonprofit providing animal rescue, adoption, and welfare services in Ridgefield and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: Whiskers Pet Rescue
shelters.description: Pet rescue organization serving the Southbury area with adoption services.

shelters.name: Friends of Feral Felines
shelters.description: Animal shelter founded in 1997 focusing on feral and community cat welfare.

shelters.name: The No Kill Project
shelters.description: Non-profit 501c(3) facilitating the creation of a no-kill society through education, advocacy, sterilization, rescue and adoption.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Connecticut animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Connecticut Humane Society (established 1881) is the state's oldest and most comprehensive animal welfare organization with multiple locations. Coverage spans Hartford, New Haven, Fairfield, and New London counties.
